name: Lantus
storageText: 16.2 Storage Dispense in the original sealed carton with the enclosed Instructions for Use. Store unused LANTUS in a refrigerator between 36°F and 46°F (2°C and 8°C). Do not freeze. Discard LANTUS if it has been frozen. Protect LANTUS from direct heat and light. Storage conditions are summarized in the following table.
